name: manyscripts-video-transcripts
description: Extract complete transcripts, captions, and metadata from public social videos.

interface.shortDescription: Transcribe public videos from six platforms.
interface.longDescription: Get complete spoken transcripts, creator captions, and useful metadata from public YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reel, X/Twitter, Facebook, and Xiaohongshu (beta) video links without leaving the conversation.
defaultPrompt: Get the complete transcript from this public video URL.
Extract the transcript and creator caption from this video.
Transcribe this video, then summarize its main points.
